judgements.justification: A had two proof-checking champions (u2eX 9, 7 h; nnEq 8, 10 h); B's only 7 came from fudr's light review, and fudr never posted again.
B's chair rejected for gaps the paper does not treat (i.i.d. baseline, cost, sample access), not for promised fixes judged too large without re-review.
B's meta-review draws its three concerns from Xcrv's and t3bd's visible reviews; A's follows the scores; no off-record input appears.
A valued the paper as an explanation of why a non-convex method works; B judged it as an approximation method and counted its missing practical payoff (i.i.d. baseline, cost) against it.
B's below-threshold scores rest on the i.i.d. baseline and practical value, central to B's reading; AWCx's 5 shows no post-rebuttal hold on a peripheral point.
